finding_1_exact_1000ms_timeout_and_did_n.summary: In `hostapd` (`/bin/wpad`), `sm_WPA_PTK_PTKSTART_Enter` (`0x00417ab8..0x00417b7c`) increments `sm->TimeoutCtr` (`0x30($a0)`) up to 4 attempts (`slti $a0, $v0, 5` at `0x00417af4`) and calls `__wpa_send_eapol`. In `wpa_send_eapol` (`0x004179a8..0x00417ab4`), when `wpa_auth->conf.tx_status != 0` (`lw $v0, 0x7c($s2)` at `0x00417a18`), if the driver reports `ack == 0` in `ieee802_1x_eapol_tx_status` (`lw $v0, 0x38($s0); bnez $v0, 0x417e54` at `0x00417e0c`), `hostapd` logs `'did not Ack EAPOL-Key frame (%scast index=%d)'` (VA `0x004997e0`, with `'uni'` at `0x004997d4`). The retry timer (`wpa_send_eapol_timeout` at `0x00419160`, which sets `sm->TimeoutEvt = 1` at `0x24($a0)`) is armed via `eloop_register_timeout` for exactly `1 s, 0 us = 1000 ms` (`addiu $a0, $zero, 1; move $a1, $zero` at `0x00417aac..0x00417ab4` when `tx_status == 0` and at `0x00417a1c..0x00417a48` on all subsequent retries `count > 1`).

finding_2_umac_is_ubnt_ptp_forces_host_8.summary: In `umac.ko` `__ol_ath_attach` (`0x0bc0c8..0x0bc140`), setting `is_ubnt_ptp=1` forces `scn->host_80211_enable = 0` (`beqz $a0, 0xbc104; ... j 0xbc114; move $v1, $zero` at `0x0bc0f0..0x0bc0fc`, `sb $v1, -0x1ce4($v0)` at `0x0bc140`), which sets `pdev->rx_decap_mode = 0` (`0x268($pdev) == 0`). Simultaneously, `ol_transfer_bin_file` (`0x0bd6b8`) checks `scn->is_ubnt_ptp` and loads the dedicated TDMA PtP target firmware `athwlan_AR9888v2_ptp_bin` (`214,299` B in WA, `215,074` B in XC) instead of `athwlan_AR9888v2_ptmp_sta_bin`.

finding_3_4addr_wds_decap_and_osif_forei.summary: In `ol_rx_deliver` (`0x0cd7c0..0x0cdb70`), host-side 4-address WDS (`FC=0x8803`, `(fc1 & 3) == 3`) 32-byte header decap (`DA = wh->i_addr3`, `SA = wh->i_addr4` at `0x0cdaf8..0x0cdb3c`) ONLY runs when `pdev->rx_decap_mode != 0` (`host_80211_enable == 1`). When `is_ubnt_ptp=1` forces `rx_decap_mode = 0`, `ol_rx_deliver` jumps to `0x0cdb50` (`beqz $v0, 0xcdb50` at `0x0cd7c4`), relying on `athwlan_AR9888v2_ptp_bin`. Then `osif_deliver_data_ol` (`0x09e0d0..0x09e22c`) runs `eth_type_trans(skb, dev)` (`0x09e158`) and checks whether `skb->protocol == 0x888e` (`ETH_P_PAE`). If `skb->pkt_type != PACKET_HOST (0)` (`0x09e168..0x09e174`, e.g. `PACKET_OTHERHOST` when 4-address `DA` `addr3` != `ath0->dev_addr`), `osif_deliver_data_ol` logs `'Received foreign EAPOL (%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x) - drop it'` (`0x09e188`) and frees the frame via `consume_skb(skb)` (`0x09e1b4`) before `wpa_supplicant` ever receives `EAPOL-Key 1/4`.

finding_4_uph_sta_connect_null_scan_ap_u.summary: In `ubnt_poll_host.ko` (`WA` and `XC`), when a STA with `is_ubnt_ptp=1` and `allow_80211=1` associates to a standard 802.11 WDS AP (no Ubiquiti Polling IE in `uph->scan_ap_list`), `ubnt_poll_host_on_assoc_req_tx` (`0x009234` WA / `0x008f00` XC) sends `ht_comm` msg `12` (`0x0c`) with `polling_enabled = 0` (`sw $zero, 0x3c($sp)`) and logs `'Associating with normal AP'`. However, upon `AssocResp` in `ubnt_poll_host_on_sta_connect` (`0x008134` WA / `0x007e6c` XC, STA branch at `0x0083b8`), `ubnt_poll_host_sta_list_find` returns `NULL` and branches at `0x0083e4` (`beqz $v0, 0x859c`) over the entire peer initialization block (`0x0083ec..0x008598`), leaving `uph->connected_ap` (`0x10f0($s0)`) as `NULL`, yet STILL transmits `ht_comm` msg `7` (`HT_COMM_STA_CONNECT`) at `0x00861c` with 600 bytes of uninitialized kernel stack (`0x32($sp)..0x24f($sp)`) to `athwlan_AR9888v2_ptp_bin`! This leaves the PtP target firmware without a valid peer descriptor for the associated AP, explaining why **Step 1 of the OTA PtP migration MUST keep the `airOS 8` side as AP (`.241`, `allow_80211=1`, `op_mode=0`) and convert the remote STA (`.242`) to OpenWrt FIRST** rather than running Stock `airOS 8` as a PtP STA against an OpenWrt AP.

authenticator_eapol_timeout_mechanics.exact_1000ms_retry_explanation: When the AP sends EAPOL-Key 1/4: (a) if wpa_auth->conf.tx_status == 0 (or on retry count > 1 at 0x00417a1c..0x00417a48), wpa_send_eapol registers wpa_send_eapol_timeout via eloop_register_timeout(1, 0, ...) = 1000 ms (`addiu $a0, $zero, 1; move $a1, $zero`); (b) if wpa_auth->conf.tx_status == 1 (OpenWrt nl80211 hostapd) and the STA fails to 802.11-ACK the frame or TX status returns ack=0 (`lw $v0, 0x38($s0); bnez $v0, 0x417e54` at 0x00417e0c), ieee802_1x_eapol_tx_status logs 'did not Ack EAPOL-Key frame (unicast index=%d)' (VA 0x004997e0) and the subsequent retry timer runs at 1000 ms (1 s, 0 us) for up to 4 attempts (`slti $a0, $v0, 5` at 0x00417af4).

mechanism_1_is_ubnt_ptp_forces_host_8021.explanation: When module param `is_ubnt_ptp=1` is set (Stock airOS 8 PtP mode), `__ol_ath_attach` at `.text+0x0bc0f0` (`beqz $a0, 0xbc104; ... j 0xbc114; move $v1, $zero`) overrides `host_80211_enable` to 0 (`sb $v1, -0x1ce4($v0)` at `0x0bc140`), setting `pdev->rx_decap_mode = 0` (`0x268($pdev)`), and `ol_transfer_bin_file` (`0x0bd6b8`) loads the dedicated TDMA PtP target firmware `athwlan_AR9888v2_ptp_bin` (214,299 B on WA; 215,074 B on XC) instead of `athwlan_AR9888v2_ptmp_sta_bin`.

mechanism_2_4addr_wds_rx_decap_and_forei.explanation: In `ol_rx_deliver` (`0x0cd7c0`), if `pdev->rx_decap_mode != 0` (`host_80211_enable=1`), the host parses 4-address WDS frames (`(fc1 & 3) == 3`, `FC=0x8803` at `0x0cd7f0: xori $t4, $t1, 3`), strips 32 bytes (`0x20`), and builds the 802.3 header from `DA = wh->i_addr3` (`0x10($a3)`) and `SA = wh->i_addr4` (`0x18($a3)` at `0x0cdaf8..0x0cdb3c`). When `is_ubnt_ptp=1` forces `rx_decap_mode = 0`, `ol_rx_deliver` skips host 802.11 decap (`beqz $v0, 0xcdb50` at `0x0cd7c4`) and relies on `athwlan_AR9888v2_ptp_bin` to decap the frame. Then `osif_deliver_data_ol` (`0x09e0d0`) calls `eth_type_trans(skb, dev)` (`0x09e158`): if `skb->protocol == 0x888e` (`ETH_P_PAE`) and `skb->pkt_type != PACKET_HOST (0)` (`lw $v0, 0x84($s0); lui $s6, 0xe0; and $v0, $v0, $s6; beqz $v0, 0x9e1bc` at `0x09e168..0x09e174` — triggered whenever 4-address `DA` (`addr3`) does not match `ath0->dev_addr`), `osif_deliver_data_ol` logs `'Received foreign EAPOL (%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x:%02x) - drop it'` and drops the EAPOL-Key 1/4 frame via `consume_skb` (`0x09e1b4`) before `wpa_supplicant` ever sees it!

mechanism_3_tx_iv_4eapol_and_1200ms_defe.explanation: On STA TX (`osif_vap_hardstart_generic` at `0x0a2414..0x0a2500`), when `wpa_supplicant` sends `EAPOL-Key 2/4` (`eh->ether_type == 0x888e`, `eapol->type == 3`, `key_data_length != 0`, `(key_info & 0x40) == 0`), `umac.ko` sets `vap->iv_4eapol = (vap->iv_4eapol & 0xf8) | 2` (`0x2695($s0)` at `0x0a24e0`), logs `'%s: 4Way pkt iv_4eapol=0x%x'`, and hands the 802.3 frame to `ol_tx_ll` (`0x3d4($s1)`). Furthermore, when `wpa_supplicant` calls `SIOCSIWENCODEEXT` (`ieee80211_ioctl_siwencodeext` at `0x0953b8`) after M3, if `(vap->iv_4eapol & 8) == 0`, `umac.ko` defers PTK/GTK key installation into `vap+0x2698`/`0x269c` and waits for target WMI event `wmi_unified_PM4_sent_handler` (`0x0a5f6c`), which arms `vap->iv_eapol_timer` for `0x4b0 = 1200 ms` (`addiu $a0, $zero, 0x4b0` at `0x0a5fb0`) before `ieee80211_setkey_timer` installs keys.

ptp_allow80211_target_state_desync.explanation: When a Stock airOS 8 radio with `is_ubnt_ptp=1` and `allow_80211=1` operates in STA mode (`op_mode == 2`) and associates to a standard 802.11 WDS AP (no Ubiquiti Polling IE in beacon/probe-resp), `ubnt_poll_host_on_assoc_req_tx` (`0x009234`) finds `scan_ap == NULL` (`0x0092bc`), sends `ht_comm` msg `0x0c` (12) with `polling_enabled = 0` (`sw $zero, 0x3c($sp)`) to `athwlan_AR9888v2_ptp_bin`, and logs `'ubnt_poll_host: Associating with normal AP'`. However, when `AssocResp` arrives and `ubnt_poll_host_on_sta_connect` (`0x008134`, STA branch at `0x0083b8`) runs, `ubnt_poll_host_sta_list_find` again returns `NULL` and branches at `0x0083e4` (`beqz $v0, 0x859c`) OVER the entire peer initialization block (`0x0083ec..0x008598`). As a result: (1) `uph->connected_ap` (`0x10f0($s0)`) remains `NULL`; (2) at `0x00859c..0x008624`, `ubnt_poll_host_on_sta_connect` STILL sends `ht_comm` msg `7` (`HT_COMM_STA_CONNECT`) to `athwlan_AR9888v2_ptp_bin` with an uninitialized 600-byte stack buffer (`0x32($sp)..0x24f($sp)` never zeroed or populated because the initialization at `0x00843c..0x008598` was skipped!); and (3) `ubnt_poll_host_on_sta_authorize` (`0x0080a4`) checks `lw $a0, 0x10f0($s0); beqz $a0, 0x8124` and exits as a no-op. Consequently, the dedicated PtP target firmware (`athwlan_AR9888v2_ptp_bin`) has corrupted/uninitialized peer state for the associated AP, stalling 4-address WDS (`FC=0x8803`) EAPOL-Key 1/4 -> 2/4 delivery across the `1000 ms` `wpa_send_eapol` retry interval.
